info.title: Fenergo Nebula Product Policy Logic Engine
info.description: Logic Engine API is part of FenX eco-system to evaluate Product Policy Requirements by logic conditions.All the operations require valid access token obtained from Identity service.

delete.summary:
Allows clearing the Logic Engine API cache.
This is an maintenance endpoint and does not need to be used under normal circumstances.
delete.description:
• Allows to flush Requirements evaluator cache
  • Allows to flush Requirement sets evaluator cache
  • Allows to flush DataGroups evaluator cache


Required permissions:
Following permissions are required: ProductConfigurationDelete
